content: {"like":["Prefers high‑intensity, burn‑focused workouts with strong motivation cues.","Enjoys DVDs that allow quick, segmented sessions for efficient training.","Values effective lower‑body exercises that improve appearance and fit.","Likes light free‑weight and varied arm movements for engaging workouts.","Enjoys cardio with twisting moves that feel fun and powerful."],"dislike":["Dislikes instructors lacking enthusiasm or drab personalities.","Avoids workouts that are too fast or risky for neck/back.","Rejects cardio that feels spastic or dizzying.","Prefers not to have too many instructional pauses or repeats.","Dislikes uneven padding or flimsy equipment that hurts knees."]}
